Barney Frank was a giant. As the first openly gay member of Congress to come out on his own terms, he paved the road for LGBTQ+ members like me and my @EqualityCaucus colleagues.

He leaves behind an extraordinary legislative legacy. As chairman of @USHouseFSC, he led the fight for the Dodd-Frank Act, reshaping American finance and protecting millions of consumers.

We lost a true trailblazer today. Rest in peace, Congressman.

Yesterday, three people were murdered at a mosque in San Diego on one of the holiest days in Islam. This is a vile and despicable act of hate, and I refuse to accept a country where worshippers cannot gather in peace without fearing for their lives. My heart is with the victims, their families, and every Muslim American who woke up afraid today.
